targets.old_statement: Renewal by mail requires a verifiable North Carolina residence, a Class C license expired no more than two years, a DMV photo from the last five years, a physician-signed vision statement, a sex offender affidavit, and an age no older than 72.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Renewal by mail requires a verifiable North Carolina residence, a Class C license expired no more than two years, a DMV photo from the last five years, a physician-signed vision statement, a sex offender affidavit, and an age no older than seventy-two.
targets.statement: Civilian renewal by mail is open to a resident outside North Carolina for at least thirty continuous days who has a permanent verifiable North Carolina residence address, a Class C license expired no more than two years, a DMV photo from the past five years, an NCDMV record of a Social Security number or federal legal-presence document, a physician-signed vision statement, a signed and dated National Sex Offender Affidavit, and an age no older than seventy-two on the request date, and it may be used only every other renewal cycle.
